title: Well-definedness of the homogeneous-localization chart map
statement:
The assignment $\theta_a$ is independent of the chosen homogeneous
representative and defines a ring homomorphism from the degree-zero
homogeneous localization to $A[I/a]$.

proof.text:
Multiplication and addition are compatible with the displayed formula.
Well-definedness follows from
[lemma-nagata-chart-ring-fraction-equality], applied to the equality
relation in homogeneous localization after forgetting the grading.

lean.note: The recorded dependency def-nagata-homogeneous-away-to-chart already supplies this exact published ring homomorphism and its formula lemma. Its domain is the quotient of degree-zero homogeneous fractions, so the map is independent of representatives; the bundled RingHom provides the ring laws. The formula lemma identifies its value as x/a^n. Section parameters are {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ I). Full published source read through scompile.py --source; no new module or duplicate theorem is needed.
